reviews.content: Ruijin handled my liver transplant evaluation perfectly. English coordinator arranged everything from visa letter to post-op hotel. Total cost was about 40% of US quotes including travel.

reviews.content: PUMC is widely regarded as China's top hospital and lived up to its reputation. My cardiology team communicated flawlessly in English throughout my 2-week stay.

reviews.author: Mohammed A.
reviews.content: Traveled from Dubai for a comprehensive health checkup. Sun Yat-sen international department handled Arabic translation. Very efficient — full workup in 4 hours.

reviews.author: Maria S.
reviews.content: Living in Manila, I took the 2-hour flight to Xiamen for dental implants. JCI accreditation gave me confidence. Cost was about 1/3 of Singapore with comparable quality.

reviews.hospital_name: The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University
reviews.author: Park J.
reviews.content: Took the ferry from Busan to Qingdao for cataract surgery. Korean coordinator was incredible. Surgery + recovery + sightseeing in 5 days. Highly recommend.
